en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 124 - It is narrated from Ahmad bin Idris from Ali bin Muhammad from Fadhl bin Shazan from Muhammad Ibn Abi Umair from Husain bin Abu Alaa from Abu Basir from Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s) that he said:

“When His Eminence, Salman Farsi entered Kufa, he glanced at it and mentioned all the troubles and events that were to occur in it till he mentioned about Bani Umayyah rulers and the period after them. After that he said: ‘When all this is over, you must remain confined to your houses till the reappearance of the master of the affair, the pure one, son of the pure and purifying. The one who has occultation and who is the ‘Shareed’ and ‘Tareed’
